description: This is a PHP class file named SuiteValidator within the SuiteCRM project. It provides utility methods for validation of IDs, keys, and percentage-related fields, with configurable validation patterns.

classes.name: SuiteCRM\Utility\SuiteValidator
classes.description: A utility class for validating IDs, keys, and specific field types within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: isValidId
methods.description: Validates whether the given ID string is valid based on the configured pattern or numeric status.

methods.name: isValidKey
methods.description: Validates whether the provided key string meets the validation pattern or is numeric.

methods.name: isPercentageField
methods.description: Determines if a given field name pertains to a percentage-related field.

methods.name: getIdValidationPattern
methods.description: Retrieves the ID validation regex pattern, considering global configuration for strict validation.

methods.name: getKeyValidationPattern
methods.description: Provides the regex pattern for key validation, configurable via global settings.
